children: NHTSA opened an audit of Tesla’s Cybercab robotaxi, asking 21 safety-compliance questions (steering, braking controls, touchscreen passenger interaction) and set a response deadline of September 30.
Tesla (TSLA) is running limited robotaxi service in six Texas and Florida cities, with supervised trips in San Francisco and planned expansion into Nevada and Arizona; no nationwide rollout yet.
Tesla (TSLA) is a primary customer for Terafab Texas, which has initial $16.8B commitments to build a 100M sq ft chip facility for Tesla and SpaceX, with potential expansion up to $119B.
Tesla (TSLA) to install Megawatt Charging System and CCS pull‑through lanes at three Forum Mobility depots in Ontario and Oakland, adding 30 MW of heavy‑duty truck charging capacity.
Traders: Analysts expect Tesla (TSLA) to sell about 1.8 million vehicles in 2026 versus ~1.6 million in 2025, indicating higher EV deliveries year-over-year.
Tesla (TSLA) will test the Semi in California ahead of a planned European launch next year; timeline and regional rollout target Europe following U.S. validation.
TSLA rose ~1.2% to $362.21 after Goldman Sachs said Q3 EV deliveries tracked near 435,000 vs. consensus ~456,000, signaling deliveries below expectations for the quarter.
Goldman Sachs kept TSLA at Hold with a $360 target after Tesla's delivery report, leaving its rating and target unchanged despite the latest delivery figures.
Forum Mobility struck a deal with Tesla (TSLA) focused on charging infrastructure expansion; no vehicle orders, usage targets, economics or Tesla payment details were disclosed.
Tesla, Inc. (TSLA) held a Cybercab launch event in Austin; attendees and investors noted the presentation lacked new information, and the Cybercab remains in limited deployment confined to Austin.
